hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.java$'; then cd /Users/jake/Documents/workspace/projectspace/live-platform-lab && module=$(echo "$file" | grep -oE 'live-[a-z-]+' | head -1); if [ -n "$module" ]; then echo "[compile] $module"; ./gradlew :${module}:compileJava -q 2>&1 | tail -20; fi; fi
